# Original Khronos Box GLB fixture

Box.glb is the unmodified Cesium Box sample, copyright 2017 Cesium,
licensed under [Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode).
Author: Cesium. No changes were made to the sample bytes.

Source: https://github.com/KhronosGroup/glTF-Sample-Assets/tree/8f492390ddc7a2ae221a1369ef560589cf8c70fb/Models/Box

The source model README is retained as upstream-README.md. `manifest.json`
records byte framing independently read with Python struct, not the native parser.
The current native checkpoint verifies container/source ownership only; scene,
geometry, material, cache/swap and GPU validation are still required.

`json-corpus.tsv` and `json-integers.tsv` are separate CC0 authored controls,
regenerated by `scripts/generate-glb-json-fixtures.py`. Python stdlib JSON
provides syntax/token expectations; Decimal supplies exact unsigned-integer
expectations without binary64 rounding. They do not inherit the Box license.

`accessor-controls.glb` and its TSV samples are CC0 authored controls generated
by `scripts/generate-glb-accessor-fixtures.py` using Python struct. Its48 low-level
accessor layouts are not a rendered scene or complete glTF conformance claim.
`accessor-invalid.tsv` has43 authored rejection contracts. `Box-accessors.tsv`
is independent sample readback of the attributed original Box above, not another
copy of the model. `accessor-manifest.json` pins counts and output hashes.

`primitive-controls.glb` and its triangle/bounds TSV files are CC0 authored
controls from `scripts/generate-glb-primitive-fixtures.py`. Nine meshes cover
local triangle topology, sparse positions, source precision and fitting bounds;
source duplicate-key override is intentional. `primitive-invalid.tsv` contains
30 malformed contracts. `Box-triangles.tsv` independently reads the attributed
original Box above in local coordinates, without applying its node transform.
`primitive-manifest.json` pins output counts/hashes. None of these prove scene,
material, skin, animation, GPU or window behavior.
